title: A Fokker-Planck Framework for Control of Epidemics
summary: We present a control framework for stochastic compartmental models in epidemiology. In this framework, rather than directly controlling the stochastic system, we perform optimal control of an associated Fokker-Planck equation, with the goal of steering the distribution of possible solutions of the stochastic system to some desirable state. In particular, this allows for robust control mechanism with uncertainty not only in the dynamics, but also in the initial data.
